items.name: SchemaDepthChecker
items.summary: A schema "transform" that doesn't actually change the schema at all. Instead, it measures the maximum depth of a schema, with a depth limit to prevent stack overflow. Useful for verifying that a schema has reasonable depth before attemptin…

methods.name: check
methods.summary: Depth-checks the given data type against a given depth limit. The return value is the largest depth seen, which is capped at one more than the depth limit (indicating the recursion was terminated).

methods.name: transform
methods.signature: fn transform(&mut self, data_type: &'a DataType) -> Self::Output<DataType>
methods.summary: General entry point for a recursive traversal over any data type. Also invoked internally to dispatch on nested data types encountered during the traversal.

methods.name: transform_array
methods.signature: fn transform_array(&mut self, atype: &'a ArrayType) -> Self::Output<ArrayType>
methods.summary: Called for each array encountered during the traversal. The provided implementation just forwards to [`Self::recurse_into_array`].
